cond_0001.intro: The purpose of this position is to test chain drive performance in simulations and within internal combustion engines or other applications.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The essential duties and responsibilities of this job are included but not limited to this job description – other tasks may be assigned and expected to be performed.
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, & engineering experimentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
Preferred Requirements
CAD & FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1~2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0063.responsibilities:
The duties and responsibilities listed here are not exhaustive — other tasks may be assigned.
Work with multi-body dynamics simulation software (ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.) to build chain system models together with the engineering team.
Analyze system and component performance in simulation software and coordinate with colleagues to correlate findings with real-world and lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre- and post-process large data files in support of the team's analysis work.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results, and share technical direction with relevant stakeholders.
Work with customers and internal teams to develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment alongside team members.
Help set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, and related equipment.
Support chain drive performance testing in engines and other applications.
cond_0063.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble and disassemble engines to install timing drives and instrumentation
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word
Preferred Requirements
CAD and FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1–2 weeks per trip
Willingness to travel internationally on occasion

cond_0203.responsibilities: Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc. Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results. Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files. Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction. Develop and provide test plans for customer issues. Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment. Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc. Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0203.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, & engineering experimentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
Preferred Requirements
CAD & FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1~2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required

The essential duties and responsibilities of this job are included but not limited to this job description – other tasks may be assigned and expected to be performed.
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0237.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
Some background in internal combustion engines, including the ability to assemble and disassemble engines to install timing drives and instrumentation.
Working knowledge of data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation.
Familiarity with Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
Ability to travel to customer or test sites around 6 times per year, with trips of roughly 1–2 weeks; occasional international travel may be required.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with CAD and FEA tools such as Solidworks, Ansys, or NX to design and analyze parts.

Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Document engineering simulation or test results and share technical findings with relevant stakeholders.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0268.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, & engineering experimentation
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1~2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required
CAD & FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)

cond_0284.intro: The purpose of this position is to test chain drive performance in simulations and within internal combustion engines or other applications. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with simulation and test work.
cond_0284.responsibilities:
The essential duties and responsibilities of this job are included but not limited to this job description – other tasks may be assigned and expected to be performed.
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0284.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, & engineering experimentation
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1~2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required
CAD & FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)

Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc. Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results. Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files. Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction. Develop and provide test plans for customer issues. Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment. Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc. Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0318.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience
Some familiarity with internal combustion engines and a willingness to learn how to assemble and disassemble engines to install timing drives and instrumentation
Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word
Background in data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation, or openness to developing these skills
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1–2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required
Exposure to CAD and FEA tools such as Solidworks, Ansys, or NX, or willingness to build these skills on the job
cond_0318.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.
cond_0318.workplace_support: We work to create an environment where employees feel supported, heard, and able to do their best work. Our approach includes flexibility, trust, and practical support that helps people thrive across changing needs and responsibilities.

Work with multi-body dynamics simulation software (ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.) to build chain system models together with the engineering team.
Analyze system and component performance in simulation software and coordinate with colleagues to correlate findings with real-world and lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre- and post-process large data files in support of the team's analysis work.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results, and share technical direction with relevant stakeholders.
Work with customers and internal teams to develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment alongside team members.
Help set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, and related equipment.
Support chain drive performance testing in engines and other applications.
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble and disassemble engines to install timing drives and instrumentation
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word
Preferred Requirements
CAD and FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1–2 weeks per trip
Willingness to travel internationally on occasion
cond_0405.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0405.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

cond_0425.responsibilities:
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0425.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of internal combustion engines and demonstrated ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation.
Strong command of Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
Substantial expertise in data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation.
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) approximately 6 times per year, 1–2 weeks per trip; international travel occasionally required.
Proven expertise in CAD & FEA to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX).
cond_0425.values: We value strong results, high standards, and the pursuit of excellent work. We believe organizations perform best when they are guided by ambition and quality.

cond_0443.intro: The purpose of this position is to test chain drive performance in simulations and within internal combustion engines or other applications.
cond_0443.responsibilities:
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0443.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering discipline required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Deep knowledge of internal combustion engines and demonstrated ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation.
Strong command of Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
Substantial expertise in data acquisition, instrumentation, and engineering experimentation.
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) approximately 6 times per year, 1–2 weeks per trip; international travel occasionally required.
Proven expertise in CAD & FEA to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX).

The essential duties and responsibilities of this job are included but not limited to this job description – other tasks may be assigned and expected to be performed.
Create chain system models using multi-body dynamics simulation software such as ADAMS, SIMDRIVE, VALDYN, GT-SUITE, etc.
Analyze system/component performance in the dynamics simulation software and correlate with real world/lab test results.
Use Microsoft Excel to pre & post process large data files.
Communicate and document engineering simulation or test results and provide technical direction.
Develop and provide test plans for customer issues.
Operate engine dynamometers, motoring stands, and other test equipment.
Set up chain system and component tests using appropriate hardware, sensors, data acquisition, etc.
Test chain drive performance in engines and other applications.
cond_0586.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
Understanding of internal combustion engines and the ability to assemble & disassemble engines to install timing drives & instrumentation
Computer skills, proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
Understanding of data acquisition, instrumentation, & engineering experimentation
Ability to travel to customer or test sites to conduct chain system evaluations (engine tests) about 6 times per year, 1~2 weeks per trip
International travel is occasionally required
CAD & FEA skills to design and analyze parts (Solidworks, Ansys, NX)

Support chain drive performance testing in engines and other applications.
